title: Junior Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Junior Developer (Software Engineering & Core API Operations)

Location:  100% Remote (Must reside in Brazil)

Liaison Hub:  Abu Dhabi, UAE

Company:  Next Match AI LLC

Reference ID:  NMAI-JDEV-BR-023

The Opportunity

Next Match AI LLC  is seeking a highly motivated, adaptable Junior Developer  to join our distributed global software engineering team. As our automated AI matching networks and foundational HR API  infrastructure experience rapid commercial adoption across North America and the GCC, we are expanding our core technical team to support feature deployment, database optimization, and high-volume data validation holds.

Operating completely remote from within Brazil, you will work alongside senior software architects to write clean code, squash system bugs, and optimize front-end and back-end modules. You will play a vital, hands-on role in scaling our cloud ecosystems, collaborating directly with our core engineering and innovation hub in Abu Dhabi .

Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development & Maintenance:  Write clean, testable code to build and refine responsive user interfaces and backend logic layers.
  • API Integration Support:  Assist in maintaining and documenting our core HR API  pathways, ensuring reliable data handshakes with third-party corporate client environments.
  • Bug Remediation:  Actively identify, debug, and resolve front-end layout shifts and server-side script errors to ensure a seamless web experience.
  • Database Optimization:  Write and optimize basic database queries, assisting senior engineers with structured data management and transactional logging.
  • Technical Documentation:  Keep internal engineering docs, API logs, and deployment workflows meticulously updated to support codebase transparency.
Who You Are (Requirements)
  • Proven Foundation Experience:  1+ years of professional software development experience, a dedicated internship background, or a robust portfolio of live full-stack web applications.
  • Core Tech Stack Familiarity:  Hands-on exposure to modern front-end tools (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Vue) and backend environments (Node.js, Python, or equivalent framework logic).
  • Database & Git Comfort:  Fundamental understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and solid familiarity with version control protocols (Git/GitHub).
  • Strong Problem-Solving Drive:  A sharp analytical mindset with an eagerness to learn complex cloud architectures under the mentorship of senior engineers.
  • Excellent Communication:  Clear, structured verbal and written English communication skills; a natural ability to collaborate effectively across remote, distributed channels. (Portuguese language capability is your native framework; English is required for architecture syncs).
  • Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical coding boot camp credentials).
Premium Compensation & Benefits

We offer a high-tier early-career compensation portfolio built to secure the region's brightest rising tech talent, positioned strictly 20% above the Brazilian market average .

  • Base Salary:  R$ 8,400 – R$ 10,500 BRL per month  (Paid out via equivalent USD stable contract options of $1,600 – $2,000 USD , dependent on portfolio depth and technical evaluation performance).
  • Remote Excellence:  100% remote workflow autonomy paired with a dedicated personal technology stipend and home-office equipment setup allowance.
  • Health & Wellness:  Comprehensive, high-tier medical insurance coverage provided fully for you and your immediate family members.

(Salary and benefits to be discussed based on experience and fit.)

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.
